result.title: A Matrix with Steps: An Episodic and Procedural Memory Method for Tool-Using Agents and Robots
result.summary: Agents that call tools and robots that execute tasks are challenged by two shortcomings: they repeat what failed before, and they learn from runs that they only believe succeeded. We describe the construction of a memory that addresses both, built for a production agent platform. Every run is recorded as an episode, and only an outcome confirmed by an external check, a test, a tool result or a person counts; the agent's own claim never does. What is learned from episodes is kept in a memory with two parts: an associative matrix, written with the delta rule, which finds the procedure that applies to a situation; and a section of ordered, addressable step records that answers what comes after a given step, where a step is a goal of the agent, not a motion. Because the matrix sums its associations, it keeps no order and cannot return or delete a single one; it serves as the finder, and order, outcome counts and deletion live in the records. We describe how execution outcomes are stored, how episodes are recalled and used for solving tasks, and the file format that stores the memory. In simulation, a robot that judged its own success and stopped when it believed it was done reported $96\%$ of its tasks as done and solved $35\%$; with external verification it solved $79%$. In a store of $100000$ synthetic episodes ($457$MB on disk), the oldest episode was still found first, no episode from another person's memory was returned, and a success vouched for only by the model was never recalled; a lookup took $16$ms on a laptop and $40$ms on a server node (median). Task outcomes were measured up to about $10000$ confirmed records, where the exact records solved every revisit at the first attempt.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为调用工具与执行任务的智能体构建双部件情景记忆：以 delta 规则写入的联想矩阵负责检索适用流程，有序可寻址的步骤记录负责顺序、计数与删除，且仅当成功由外部检查或工具结果确认时才入库。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自判成功与外部核验的成功率差距」及可寻址步骤检索，可能为 LVR 中停止决策、latent 内容的验证式监督与按状态检索提供核查线索，但工作在无视觉的多模态之外。
